gearswap.button.tooltip: Open gear presets (main hand + offhand + 4 armor pieces)
gearswap.gui.slot_hint.detail: This slot only takes gear for its own part: helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots - one item per slot.
gearswap.gui.slot_hint.offhand.detail: The offhand takes anything - weapons, shields, torches, food. Stackable items go in as a whole stack.
gearswap.hud.title: Hold %s to pick a preset
gearswap.message.prevented: Some armor is bound by a curse and cannot be removed
